steps.title: Distribute small water volumes
steps.instruction: Using the p20 single‑channel pipette, dispense water volumes of 10 µL or less from the single water tube into each destination well of the 96‑well plate as specified in the uploaded CSV (which provides water volume, source rack or plate number, and destination well).

steps.title: Distribute large water volumes
steps.instruction: Using the p300 single‑channel pipette, dispense water volumes greater than 10 µL (up to 50 µL) from the single water tube into each destination well of the 96‑well plate according to the uploaded CSV (water volume, source rack or plate number, and destination well).

steps.title: Transfer RNA and mix
steps.instruction: For each of up to 96 input RNA samples, use the appropriate pipette (p20 for ≤10 µL, p300 for >10 µL) to transfer the RNA volume (1–50 µL) from its source location—either a well of a single 96‑well RNA source plate or a tube (A1‑D6) in one of up to four 24‑tube racks (rack numbers 1‑4)—to the corresponding destination well (A1‑H12) indicated in the CSV, then mix the RNA with the water already added.
